941:* **`secretSelection`** is a GRANT, not a pin: the environment is the boundary, so a run receives the secrets it lists and not
hing else. There is no "all of them" mode, an empty list is rejected (revoke with `"secretSelection": null` on update), and a `sha
ring: "user"` secret still reaches only sessions its owner started.
1009:* **`sessions send --effort <level>`** — a per-request effort, pinned on the

I take a skill ID (`eval run --compose-skill`, `eval cases run --compose-skill`, `environments ensure-adhoc --skill`) and until no
w there was no way to discover those IDs without opening the web app. Authoring stays in the app — these commands are read-only.

r-user allowance instead of your organization's credits). If the actual split differs, the launch is refused with a `409` and noth
ing is created. Omit to accept whatever split applies. |
